description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides utilities for integrating with Google Calendar via OAuth using Supabase for authentication. It includes methods to obtain OAuth tokens, fetch Google Calendar events, convert them to internal meeting objects, and handle deduplication. The file is specific to the 'googleIntegrationService' within the project's 'services' directory, focusing on Google Calendar and OAuth token management.

methods.name: getGoogleAccessToken()
methods.description: Retrieves the current Google OAuth access token from the Supabase session, checking various possible locations within the session data.

methods.name: fetchGoogleEvents({ accessToken, timeMin, timeMax, maxResults = 250, singleEvents = true, orderBy = 'startTime', calendarId = 'primary', } = {})
methods.description: Uses the Google Calendar API to fetch events within a specified time range, requiring the OAuth access token.

methods.name: toMeetingObjects(events = [], userId)
methods.description: Converts raw Google Calendar event data into internal meeting objects suitable for the application's storage and processing.

methods.name: mergeWithoutDuplicates(existing = [], incoming = [])
methods.description: Merges new meetings into an existing array while preventing duplicates based on external_event_id, particularly for Google events.
